thread:
maria: FYI urgent escalation from NovaCart — their rerank endpoint started returning noticeably different scores after our model swap this morning. They say identical inputs produce reordering. No 5xxs on their calls, but ranking is inconsistent. Pasting sample request + outputs below.

alex: Can you drop the request_id(s) and a minimal payload we can repro with? Also the time window and region? @samir might need the pool info.

maria: request_id: rc_20260214_7a9f2c, region: eu-west, pool: re-rank-eu-1. Payload (minimal):
```json
{
  "queries": ["Find vegan protein bars near me"],
  "candidates": ["VegaBar Classic", "GreenSnack Protein", "NutriBar Vegan"],
  "k": 3,
  "model": "redwood-rerank-v1.4"
}
```

maria: Customer provided before/after scores (they ran their integration test):
```text
v1.3 -> [0.92, 0.85, 0.13]
v1.4 -> [0.74, 0.86, 0.06]
```

maria: Note: same exact payload, same timestamps in their harness (they pinned request headers). They reported no auth or billing errors.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: redwood-rerank-v1.4 rolled out to pool=re-rank-eu-1 at 2026-02-14T03:12:04Z by ci/cd (sha: b7c3f9).

ops-bot: Model config diff (v1.3 -> v1.4) -- highlights: `whitespace_normalization: true` added, `tokenizer_version` bump, and quantization path switched to `int8-fast`. Full diff stored in /deploys/changes/b7c3f9.patch.

samir: Quick hypothesis: whitespace_normalization or tokenizer_version bump can change token boundaries which affects attention patterns and rerank logits. int8 quantization might also alter score granularity. Both could explain reordering for near-tie candidates.

alex: Agreed. Two immediate repros: 1) run our local rerank harness against v1.3 and v1.4 using the exact tokenizer output to see token-level differences; 2) reproduce with model served behind the same routing policy (to rule out fallback to different variant). I'll attach a comparison script.

maria: Repro curl (customer gave this):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <cust-token>" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: rc_20260214_7a9f2c" \
  -d '{"queries":["Find vegan protein bars near me"],"candidates":["VegaBar Classic","GreenSnack Protein","NutriBar Vegan"],"k":3}'
```

maria: Attached their raw outputs (they redacted text but kept scores). They asked if we can rollback while we investigate.

samir: Infra action items:
- Dump tokenizer outputs for both model versions for this payload (token ids + whitespace markers).
- Run v1.4 with fp16 (if supported) to check quantization impact.
- Check routing logs to confirm org-level routing didn't select a different family (v1.4 variant vs v1.4-quant).

ops-bot: Route check: Customer org=novacart is on default routing (no pin). Traffic to re-rank-eu-1 used model variant `v1.4-int8-fast` at 03:12:10Z for ~95% of requests for that pool.

jia: Customer wants an ETA for rollback. If safe, can we pin their org to v1.3? We should confirm no other customers need v1.4 fixes in that pool.

samir: We can create an org-binding to pin novacart to v1.3 for that pool. Rollback checklist: ensure model artifacts still available in storage and confirm resource capacity. If approved, ~30–45m to enact and propagate.

alex: I'll run the comparison script now — will post token diffs and softmax logits. If we see only tokenization changes with downstream big score deltas, we should treat as a behavioral change and coordinate a changelog + opt-in.

maria: I've opened INC-20260214-1187 (priority P1) with customer updates and asked if they want immediate rollback. They asked to wait 1 hour for our initial analysis.

alex: Update: quick local run shows tokenization diff: v1.3 tokens `[...] \"veg\",\"an\",\"protein\",\"bars\" ...` vs v1.4 `[...] \"vegan\",\"protein\",\"bars\" ...` — merges changed attention distribution. Softmax logits changed enough to flip top candidate in this example. Pasting snippet next.

samir: Thanks. That matches my expectation. Recommend two paths: 1) rollback for NovaCart while we evaluate downstream impact and prepare a controlled rollout of tokenizer change (changelogs + opt-in), or 2) apply a tokenizer-compat shim for sensitive rerank models. I'll prepare a proposal.

jia: I'll inform NovaCart of the options and the ~30–45m rollback ETA if they want it.

maria: Thanks team — will coordinate with customer and keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
